correctness.summary: The proof follows from Bieberbach for b1, the area theorem for the reciprocal tail, two exact weighted Cauchy-Schwarz estimates, and an explicit identity for the class-U functional. The threshold enclosure is checked by positive partial sums with an explicit elementary tail bound.

originality.scope: to the best of our knowledge
originality.summary: The direct 2013 source gives the universal bound sigma >= 3/2 and poses the smallest-sigma problem; its nonvanishing proof coarsens the exact weighted tail. Searches of exact, synonymous, convolution, multiplier and later-citation formulations found no statement of the exact Hilbert-envelope criterion or the threshold below 1.413520. Two earlier related transform papers were checked at abstract level and state more restrictive input classes; their full texts remain a residual risk.

value.summary: The result gives a concrete new upper bound for an explicit published open problem, a reusable reciprocal multiplier theorem, and an exact barrier for what can be obtained from the Bieberbach and area-theorem coefficient constraints alone.

limitations: The exact smallest universal sigma is not determined.
The support-function sharpness is only for the relaxed coefficient body, not the actual coefficient body of S.
Full texts of the 2007 and 2009 related transform papers were not inspected.
An unindexed or differently notated equivalent result may exist.
Independent audit has not been performed.
review_statement: Same-model review: passed. Independent audit: not yet performed.
